canonical_source.behavior: The source button formats AI WordPress Manager Error, Error ID, Correlation ID and copy-time, then awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText. It does not mutate server, tenant, WordPress or provider state.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The real authenticated Error surface renders only already-sanitized request/correlation IDs into an escaped application/json payload. Browser runtime adds copy-time at invocation and writes the source-equivalent report to Clipboard. Success is exposed only after writeText resolves; rejection/unavailable Clipboard produces a truthful retryable failure state; duplicate in-flight copies are suppressed.

runtime_path: RequestCorrelation middleware sanitizes or generates tracking IDs
canonical Copy error details button AIMW-SYNC-89777052CB
confirmed success or truthful retryable failure

security.authentication: required by the current canonical.error route auth middleware; unauthenticated requests redirect to login
security.tenant_context: not resolved by the tenant-neutral Error route; tenant-qualified/direct-ID Error paths are absent and fail 404
security.proof: Focused Feature coverage verifies authentication, absence of a tenant-qualified/direct-ID Error surface, malicious caller tracking-header rejection, and non-exposure of exception/query secrets, stack traces or exception messages.

coverage: exact canonical identity/domain/kind/source/control and generated terminal state
real rendered canonical button and escaped safe payload
authenticated Error route and zero tenant-qualified/direct-ID surface
duplicate-click suppression while write is pending

implementation.exact_head_policy: Terminal handoff is valid only when PR Plan Link, Laravel AIWMWeb Cross-Domain Security and Laravel AIWMWeb Acceptance all succeed on the final PR head. Exact run IDs are recorded in Issue #257 handoff rather than predeclared in this source artifact.
